purpose: Single registry of external data sources and their permitted uses inside NanoJev. Every external source defaults to evaluation-only: no training rows, no calibration-fit rows, no per-item-failure-driven tuning. A source may graduate only through an explicit protocol amendment and owner action; this file is the audit anchor.
global_rule: External model outputs — answers, probabilities, distributions, per-task records — must never enter any NanoJev training, calibration-fitting, distillation or teacher-label path. Aggregate leaderboard/topic statistics may inform only the planning of independently authored new item families; copying, paraphrasing or relabeling external items is prohibited.
